methodologyNotes: Thirteen inline skates were verified 2026-08-11 primarily against Inline Warehouse (a major US skate retailer whose product pages reproduce manufacturer spec sheets in structured form) and, where that retailer did not carry the exact seed model, directly against the manufacturer's own site (K2 Skates, Powerslide); three seed items could not be confirmed as currently-sold real products and were swapped for the closest real, currently-listed sibling from the same brand rather than invented: (1) "Bont Prostar Inline" does not exist in Bont's current inline lineup (Prostar is a Bont quad/artistic roller boot) — replaced with Bont's actual current race-oriented inline model, the Bont Semi Race III (a convertible 3x125mm/4x110mm race skate), which is retained in the 3x125mm configuration for the specs below; (2) "Seba FR1" is a discontinued mid-2000s model no longer sold by Seba or any fetched retailer — replaced with Seba's current comparable urban/freestyle model, the Seba Trix 2 80; (3) "Micro MT Plus" could not be located on micro-mobility.com or any fetched retailer (search engines were unavailable/blocked for this query) and was dropped rather than guessed, leaving 13 verified products. "Rollerblade Macroblade 100 3WD", "Rollerblade Zetrablade Elite", "Rollerblade Twister XT", and "Rollerblade Twister 110" were confirmed via Inline Warehouse's product pages because rollerblade.com itself returned a bot-blocked (403) response on direct fetch. "Powerslide Next 100" corresponds to the currently-sold "Next Core Black 100 II" (Powerslide renames/revises the Next line by generation); "Powerslide Zoom Pro" matched exactly as the current Zoom Pro Black 80. Powerslide's own site displays EUR-only pricing with no USD list price found on any fetched source, so priceUsd is null with a EUR priceNote for both Powerslide entries and for K2 Trio LT 100 (k2skates.com also EUR-only); no currency conversion was guessed. brake_included is null for K2 Trio LT 100 because no fetched source states it either way. accessedAt 2026-08-11 throughout.
